scope: Interface clarification for already-approved T05C before task baseline or implementation

Use a dedicated correction journal; reject coexisting journal types and third-state files unchanged.
MAX across all credible lineage counters; increment fixes only, preserve retries/corrections MAX; reject exhausted limits before token mutation.
Qualifying review/verification failures require valid actors; a gate-only failure does not require absent actors.
status: Design preflight issues resolved before implementation; no T05C runtime attempts spent.
